html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

A brutal struggle for supremacy
over the vast universe has begun!

 

The theme for this November Update is War of Kings.

 

Lilandra, the great Majestrix of the Shi'ar Empire,
Deathbird, the Empire's traitor with ruthless wings,
and Vulcan, the Omega-level mutant and avatar of destruction,
have joined MARVEL Future Fight with Tier-3 and Tier-4 abilities.

 

Also, a new Epic Quest has been added where you can enjoy
the story of heroes unfolding on a new battlefield,
alongside new Comic Cards to boost our Agents' combat power.

 

Please check below for more details on these and various other improvements designed 
to make your gameplay experience more convenient!

 

 

 

▣ Three New Heroes
 
Check out the abilities of Lilandra <Majestrix Lilandra>, 
a skilled warrior who masters the Empire's melee and ranged weapons,
Deathbird <Uncanny X-Men>, who overwhelms enemies 
with swift wing-powered mobility and razor-sharp talons,
and Vulcan <War of Kings>, who boasts Omega-level destructive firepower.
* The skill effects of the new heroes are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Lilandra, Deathbird, and Vulcan Tier-3 & Tier-4
​
① Lilandra

 

A Tier-4 Striker Skill and a Tier-3 Ultimate Skill have been added for Lilandra.
She will steadfastly protect peace and order against those who oppose the Shi'ar Empire.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

② Deathbird

 

A Tier-4 Striker Skill and a Tier-3 Ultimate Skill have been added for Deathbird.
Who can stop her deadly path, stained with blood and betrayal?
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

③ Vulcan

 

A Tier-4 Striker Skill and a Tier-3 Ultimate Skill have been added for Vulcan.
He will unleash his raging fury and uncontrollable destructive power to reduce the battlefield to ashes.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ Hulk and Vulcan Max Level Expansion

 

After the November update, the maximum level of Hulk and Vulcan will be expanded.
Experience the thrill of surpassing limits and reaching new heights.

 

* The max level expansion for each hero will proceed sequentially through updates.

 


▣ New Epic Quest [War of Kings] & Improvements

 

▶ New Epic Quest

 

Introducing the new Epic Quest theme added in the November update,
<War of Kings>.

 

 

1. Follow the journey of Native Tier-2 Lilandra and witness the story that unfolds around her.

 

 

- Lilandra is a Native Tier-2 hero who can only be upgraded through the Epic Quest.
- Lilandra's Tier-2 Passive is applied immediately upon acquisition.
- Lilandra can advance to Tier-3 through Epic Quest Progression Rewards, without Potential Search or Enhancement.

 

2. By meeting the hero ownership / upgrade requirements in the False Emperor menu,
you can acquire the Native Tier-3 hero Vulcan.

 

 

- Upgrade all required heroes shown at the bottom of the screen to the indicated specs to acquire Native Tier-3 Vulcan.

 

3. Special rewards and exclusive stage benefits are available
through the Epic Quest - Deluxe Pack or Special Deluxe Pack.

 

[Deluxe Pack] - Purchase with Crystals to use the benefits.

 

[Special Deluxe Pack] 
Available via in-app purchase. 
Includes the basic Deluxe benefits + 1,000 Crystals and 2,500 VIP Points instantly.

 

[Epic Quest: War of Kings Deluxe Basic Benefits]
1. Story Completion Rewards - Additional Deluxe rewards available
2. Instantly acquire 6★ Deathbird
3. Instantly unlock the Royal Pains mission

 

 

* The Epic Quest: War of Kings - Deluxe / Epic Quest: War of Kings - Special Deluxe packs 
cannot both be purchased and can only be purchased once per account.
* The Epic Quest: War of Kings - Deluxe benefits apply immediately upon purchase,
so Crystal refund requests may be limited after purchase.
* The Epic Quest: War of Kings - Special Deluxe effects apply immediately upon opening the pack in the Inbox, so refund requests may be limited after purchase.
* The special stage unlocked after purchasing either Deluxe Pack remains available permanently.

 

4. Special items can be acquired through the Epic Quest Collection <Imperial Guard Training Academy>.
Collection materials can be acquired based on a set probability after clearing each stage.

 

 

 

▶ Improvements

 

1. Improved Epic Quest stage Sweep so that you can set the number of Sweeps yourself.
- 1 time / Max (daily limit) → Set your desired number of Sweeps

 


▣ New Comic Cards & Collection


5 new Comic Cards themed around <War of Kings> have been added.
Collect all of these Comic Cards, which grant powerful options, and raise them to Mythic grade
to receive the Collection reward 'Recovery Rate ↑ +3%'.
* These Comic Cards can be acquired after the November update maintenance
from Store - Dimension Chest - Comic Card Chest.
* Some of the War of Kings themed Comic Cards can also be acquired through gameplay.
* 'Premium Comic Card: Fantastic Four (1961) #49' has been newly added to the list of obtainable items in Store - Premium Comic Card Chest, which is purchased with Premium Comic Card Exchange Tokens.
[War of Kings (2009) #1] cannot be acquired from this Chest.
* The effects are based on the highest quality and grade.

 

* Please note that the Premium Comic Card 'War of Kings (2009) #1' does not stack
with the Energy Attack increase activation rate option of other Comic Cards.
 

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Artifacts
​
After the November update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Lilandra, Deathbird, and Vulcan will be added.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 

 

​​New Special Icons for Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, one from the Special Pass product,
and one more from the Deluxe product (Epic Quest: War of Kings)!

 

[November Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deals

 

1. Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 11/17 Maintenance - 12/15 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 11/17 Maintenance - 12/15 (Tue) 6:59 (PST)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Odin's Blessing: Added an Auto Awaken feature.

 

 

 

When using Auto Awaken, you can select the material items and set the number of Auto Awaken attempts,
and materials will be consumed in the order shown in the material selection list.
- If you select a locked item, a pop-up will appear asking you to confirm its use.
- Available materials: Mythic Enchanted Uru, Odin's Blessing, Engraved Odin's Blessing, Odin's Glory
Use the filter at the bottom of the material selection to use materials of each grade.
- Auto Awaken ends when an Awakening Super Success occurs, the set number of attempts is used up,
or the Stop button is tapped.

 

 

- Auto Awaken can also be used from the hero's Equip Uru screen.

 

2. Improved the display text so that purchase information for certain Uniforms is clearly shown.
- Ex) Medusa <Ancient Curse>: Unavailable → Available for purchase in <Autumn Season>

 

3. Giant Boss Raid: Master Mold's summoning pattern has been changed.

 

4. Corrected an item name in the Prime Token Shop.
- Brilliant C.T.P. Selection Conversion Ticket → Brilliant C.T.P. Selection Exchange Ticket

 

5. An Instinct slot has been added to the hero information pop-up.

 

 


▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. Fixed an issue where the basic Type Enhancement advantage damage was not applied to heroes at Lv.81 or higher.

 

2. Dormammu: Fixed the following display issues.
- Dormammu (All Uniforms): Fixed an issue where some visual effects were not displayed properly
when using the Ultimate Skill while the Striker Skill was active.
- Dormammu <The Living Dark Planet>: Fixed an issue where certain parts appeared transparent when viewed from the side.

 

3. Giant Boss Raid "Onslaught"
- Fixed an issue where some skills did not work properly after Onslaught used its special pattern attack at 35% HP or below in Phase 2.

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
